dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High visibility of thin, high-contrast pale edges on the median and greater coverts, creating multiple narrow horizontal bands across the wing.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Extremely prominent and sharp pale borders along the margins of the folded primary and secondary feathers, contrasting sharply with the dark interior of the feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low linearity; the transition is characterized by a gradual increase in the frequency and contrast of pale feather-edging from the crown to the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Conspicuous pale patch in the auricular region, providing high contrast against the dark crown and malar area.
